entries.name: Member-scoped assistant
entries.summary: Give an installed agent a goal; review its proposed actions before confirming them.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Agent run and execution chain
entries.summary: Inspect the original run trace, structured drafts and cross-application execution links.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Application runtime diagnostics
entries.summary: Inspect authorized current and historical resource-linked runs without claiming exclusive application origin.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Application sessions
entries.summary: Share declared presentation state across pages of one scoped application instance.
constraints: Application owns scalar declarations and bounded queries. Pages use typed shared bindings; windows remain read-only, ephemeral and member-scoped.

entries.name: Controlled page composition
entries.summary: Render original Page sections with shared selection and filters; composition disables writes.
constraints: Named record selections keep same-object lists independent; parent bindings scope related sections.
Form inputs read declared record paths. The original action checks writes; unavailable sources do not become manual inputs.

entries.name: Published code function call
entries.summary: Bind a published Go/Wasm operation to a page using its original owner contract.
constraints: A runtime call needs the actual host, a published owner revision and the current member’s permissions.
The offline preview shows the binding only and never executes Wasm or reads tenant data.
entries.snippet:
import { ComputeCall } from "@platform/app";
<ComputeCall binding={publishedOperation} bindings={inputs} record={selected} recordType="your.object" />

entries.name: Bound dashboard
entries.summary: Render the existing chart specification over the member’s permitted aggregates.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Decision confirmation
entries.summary: Match one decision's confirmation to its original tenant and idempotency key.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Authorized workflow run
entries.summary: Inspect a workflow's recorded version and startup release through the member's original read permissions.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Generated record form
entries.summary: Edit fields from the original object declaration; submit through the owning action.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.
entries.snippet:
import { GeneratedForm } from "@platform/app";
<GeneratedForm type="your.object" submitLabel="Create" onSubmit={submit} onCancel={cancel} />

entries.name: Authorized cross-application search
entries.summary: Search records and knowledge through the current member’s original read endpoints.
constraints: Results come from the current member’s host. The offline example searches synthetic records only.
This search currently has no dedicated error or pending feedback; callers must not claim otherwise.

entries.name: Original window statistics reader
entries.summary: Read recent business-time window statistics through the original authorized aggregate owner.
constraints: The original host owns matching membership, time order, numeric semantics and the atomic read. The reader validates exact request echoes and discards old scopes, revisions or attempts without downloading records or retrying another mode.

entries.name: Authorized calculation run
entries.summary: Read the original computation binding and result; retry through the original authorized effect action.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Page workspace and preview
entries.summary: The same list-detail descriptor serves a live workspace and a read-only sample preview.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Declared action controls
entries.summary: Render original action payloads and offered transitions without duplicating role rules.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.
entries.snippet:
import { RecordActions } from "@platform/app";
<RecordActions type="your.object" record={record} steps />

entries.name: Record collaboration services
entries.summary: Post comments and attach real file bytes through the original record's authorized service actions.
constraints: Capture the original record and a current lease. Confirmed metadata never substitutes for authorized byte reads; queued decisions remain durable after a view retires.

entries.name: Authorized record detail
entries.summary: Read a record with history, tasks and the actions offered to the current member.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Original record exploration
entries.summary: Traverse retained original relationships, confirm every record and preserve authorized window totals.
constraints: The bounded path and original traversal reader grant no extra record access. Counts retain original totals; typed output ports keep heterogeneous records separate.

entries.name: Original row decisions
entries.summary: Submit original typed row targets and revisions, preserving unanswered decision keys.
constraints: The original host owns authorization, validation and approval. An unanswered row can only resend its original decision with identical payload and revision; retiring a window ends new submissions.

entries.name: Authorized record list
entries.summary: Browse records, choose a record and save a list view through the member’s host.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Typed semantic selection
entries.summary: Choose an authorized object or property from the existing registry without writing internal identifiers.
constraints: The selector returns typed references. Host validation and original permissions remain authoritative.

entries.name: Tenant reference selection
entries.summary: Choose an application, role, protocol or member from the tenant's existing directory.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Caller work services
entries.summary: Confirm offered approval requests and use the member's original approval and notification decisions.
constraints: The original inbox offers tasks; request IDs and revisions authorize approval decisions. Retiring a view never cancels a queued decision.

entries.name: Semantic tokens
entries.summary: Use shared surface, text, focus and status tokens across themes.
constraints: Use semantic tokens instead of assigning domain meaning to raw colors.

entries.name: Controlled blank space
entries.summary: Reserve one caller-owned blank region independently of container gaps.
constraints: The document owner validates finite sizes against the original layout budget. Zero is preserved; the region is hidden from accessibility and is not a focus target.

entries.name: Master-detail interaction
entries.summary: Keep selection and detail together using the existing record workspace or controlled table/detail sections.
constraints: List selection is shared by details and actions. The object contract and current member’s read scope remain authoritative.
This pattern recommends a composition; it does not grant widget eligibility or permissions.

entries.name: App Shell / Workspace
entries.summary: Compose app navigation, routed tabs, commands and session context in one shell.
constraints: Applications reuse Workspace; app navigation and views come from their AppUI declaration.
Open this full-window preview separately; its shell owns routes and saved layout.

entries.name: Workshop module workbench
entries.summary: The project's module: its pages, header and navigation, with the page editor inside and a live preview.
constraints: The local example uses synthetic application membership. Save, release and navigation actions cannot reach a host.
Application resources refer to original owners; membership does not grant access. Release review freezes published dependencies using the existing candidate path.

entries.name: Logic design workbench
entries.summary: Compose typed platform blocks with the existing native workflow editor and shared canvas.
constraints: The local example demonstrates a payload and result flow in the flow workbench; it does not execute a process.
Installed blocks, versions, permissions, testing and activation come from the connected owner APIs.

entries.name: Object design workbench
entries.summary: Inspect and edit fields, lifecycle states, transitions and access through the existing object designer.
constraints: This is the object type workbench with synthetic local data. Save and publish are refused in Catalog.
A tenant object must be created, tested and published in the connected Application Studio.
Action conditions compare declared record paths or inputs with a fixed value or another compatible field; related reads and approval retries use the original action and current requester permissions.

entries.name: Page design workbench
entries.summary: Edit the original page draft with layout gestures, scoped commands, inspectors and undo history.
constraints: The local example uses the production PageEditor with synthetic records. Host writes, save and publication are refused in Catalog.

entries.name: Reusable query workbench
entries.summary: Author fixed record conditions and retain explicit query versions for shared page plans.
constraints: The local example uses synthetic query and object descriptors. Save and publication cannot reach a host.
Queries use the original record reader and member permissions. Pages explicitly choose a retained source version; later drafts and publications do not replace it.

entries.name: Record handling workspace
entries.summary: Select a record, inspect its details and use the original object actions.
constraints: Studio requires an object and visible fields; actions are chosen from the current member’s original action catalog.
The output is a build.page draft. It never publishes, generates tenant TSX or bypasses release validation.
Template identity and revision are recorded in the editable page description as informative provenance.

entries.name: Workshop module migration
entries.summary: Map a bounded source page into the original V2 draft with explicit bindings, source preservation and blocking diagnostics.
constraints: The 92-type migration inventory grants no runtime eligibility. Eight source widget types have bounded configuration profiles; unsupported settings block application.
The local example compiles synthetic source data without a host. Import applies only an undoable page draft; save, permissions and release validation stay with their original owners.
Download the original JSON and mapping report before leaving the editor. Reports remain in the current editing scope until it closes or its member changes.

entries.name: Original AI result
entries.summary: Present authorized retained function results and controlled conversation input.
constraints: The caller owns fixed functions, confirmed record context, original call IDs, permissions and lifecycle. This UI never simulates replies or executes generated code.

entries.name: Application header
entries.summary: Render authorized application navigation and read or appearance controls in a shared horizontal or vertical header.

entries.name: Original approval tasks
entries.summary: Compose each offered task with its authorized original request and caller-owned approval decisions.
constraints: The caller owns offered tasks, original request reads, action permission, submission and async state. Task and request IDs and revisions remain separate; unreadable or incompatible requests cannot expose approval actions.

entries.name: Retained asset directory
entries.summary: Present literal directory entries with their actual retained asset identity and version.
constraints: The caller maps actual discoverable assets and authorizes page navigation. Source placeholder names do not create resources, URLs or implicit bindings; non-page entries remain read-only.

entries.name: Typed block canvas
entries.summary: Compose nodes through typed ports with one shared graph interaction model.
constraints: The canvas owns interaction; its caller owns graph semantics, validation and persistence.

entries.name: Original navigation trail
entries.summary: Present original navigation identities and a controlled current location with literal labels and record details.
constraints: The caller owns page navigation, confirmed record identity and clearing the original producer. Duplicate labels remain distinct; an optional current-page action clears context without invoking ancestor navigation. Read-only trails do not invoke callbacks.

entries.name: Button
entries.summary: One action control with primary, quiet, destructive, link and row variants.

entries.name: Button group
entries.summary: Activate stable scoped presentation controls through caller-owned bindings.
constraints: Each control has a stable identity; the caller owns its binding, permissions and execution.

entries.name: Layout canvas editor
entries.summary: Move, order and resize controlled layout regions with pointer previews and atomic caller-owned edits.
constraints: The caller owns the layout document, accepted edits and scope validation. Pointer previews never publish or mutate business data.

entries.name: Chart
entries.summary: Render a visualization spec using inline values or a scoped aggregate source.

entries.name: Checkbox
entries.summary: A labelled boolean choice with an explicit disabled state.

entries.name: Single choice input
entries.summary: Present caller-owned static choices as a select, radio group, segmented control, steps or tabs.
constraints: The caller owns the original string state, options and query conditions. Empty or unmatched values are preserved until explicit selection.
Steps and tabs use canonical index string values and a same-length label list; duplicate labels remain separate choices. An absent write callback renders them read-only.

entries.name: Original collection counts
entries.summary: Present complete original group counts as horizontal bars or signed steps with cumulative values.
constraints: The caller owns original group values and counts. No data query, Vega specification or financial waterfall engine runs in this component.

entries.name: Collection title
entries.summary: Show a declared collection name and its caller-owned complete count.
constraints: The caller owns the authorized complete count and clears obsolete values.

entries.name: Context commands
entries.summary: Use the same commands from a pointer context menu or an explicit keyboard and touch trigger.
constraints: The caller owns commands and disabled states; the menu does not perform business operations itself.

entries.name: Content tabs
entries.summary: Switch stable named panels with keyboard navigation and retain visited content.

entries.name: Complete typed count matrix
entries.summary: Present original complete counts with distinct axis identities and optional controlled heatmap selection.
constraints: The caller owns complete authorized counts and filter writes. Missing, empty and literal values remain distinct; no grouping, truncation or record reads happen here.

entries.name: Authorized proportional treemap
entries.summary: Partition caller-owned complete group counts into proportional rectangles with independently accessible groups.
constraints: The caller owns authorized complete counts and filter writes. Layout never inflates small groups, reads records or writes business data.

entries.name: Data table
entries.summary: Browse, sort and edit typed rows in a shared virtualized table.

entries.name: Civil date input
entries.summary: Edit original business date text with a native picker and explicit invalid draft repair.
constraints: The caller owns the original date text and query conditions. Invalid drafts remain visible; no local timezone or timestamp conversion is applied.

entries.name: Offset datetime input
entries.summary: Edit caller-owned timestamp text without browser timezone conversion or precision truncation.
constraints: The caller owns original text and query conditions. UTC offset is explicit; seconds and up to nine fractional digits are retained, and invalid drafts remain repairable.

entries.name: Original derived mean
entries.summary: Present the original complete-set count and numeric average without recomputing a loaded window.
constraints: The original host owns numeric and missing-value semantics. Empty averages remain empty and the explicit unit grants no business conversion.

entries.name: Entity relationship canvas
entries.summary: Explore and arrange entity relationships with zoom, pan, layouts and caller-owned linking.
constraints: The caller supplies semantic icons, hierarchy edges, permissions and persistence.

entries.name: Modal dialog
entries.summary: Ask for a bounded decision with focus trapping and a labelled title.

entries.name: Disclosure
entries.summary: Reveal supporting details while keeping the summary visible.

entries.name: Editor workbench
entries.summary: Arrange a library, canvas and inspector with keyboard and pointer pane resizing.

entries.name: Record summary
entries.summary: Present a record's title, status and labelled properties.

entries.name: Schema form
entries.summary: Render labelled editors and validate an ad hoc schema before submission.

entries.name: Isolated external document
entries.summary: Display a fixed HTTPS document at its exact reviewed origin.
constraints: All sandbox restrictions remain enabled; no platform token, input or message bridge is provided. Scripts and form submissions are disabled. Remote bytes are not a versioned platform artifact.

entries.name: Facet choices
entries.summary: Choose several authorized options with complete source counts and an optional histogram.
constraints: The caller owns authorized options, counts and typed selected values.

entries.name: Typed field vocabulary
entries.summary: One field type owns display, editing, validation, sorting and filtering.
constraints: Reference links need a Workspace; attachment upload needs an explicit caller implementation.

entries.name: File picker
entries.summary: Pick a local file through a shared button; the caller owns upload.
constraints: Picking a file does not upload or publish it.

entries.name: Typed filters
entries.summary: Build filters from the entity's declared fields and operators.

entries.name: Flow observation
entries.summary: Inspect a native flow's graph, waiting steps and decision trace.

entries.name: Flow layout and toolbar
entries.summary: Wrap presentation items and navigate toolbar buttons with arrow keys.

entries.name: Form submission
entries.summary: Submit an ad hoc form on Enter without reloading the page.

entries.name: Authorized numeric gauge
entries.summary: Display the original finite numeric aggregate with a bounded arc and warning threshold.
constraints: The caller owns the original numeric result and complete set. The gauge does not substitute zero for empty or denied values.

entries.name: Read-only graph
entries.summary: Observe relationships and execution paths through the shared canvas.

entries.name: Numeric distribution
entries.summary: Present complete caller-owned bins with exact bounds, counts and missing-value disclosure.
constraints: The caller owns authorized complete bins. The control validates intervals and counts without re-binning, and never writes records.

entries.name: Image annotation
entries.summary: Inspect original raster bytes and edit normalized, revision-bound region proposals.
constraints: The original attachment and author permissions belong to Files. The caller confirms saves at the captured file revision; refused drafts remain local and view retirement never cancels accepted decisions.

entries.name: Steps and tabs
entries.summary: Select original string identities through ordered steps or semantic tabs with independently keyed labels.
constraints: The caller owns current state and optional writes. Duplicate labels retain distinct values; empty or unmatched state has no current choice. Step position makes no business workflow claim and tabs do not invent panel content.

entries.name: Input controls
entries.summary: Text, select and multiline controls for explicit labelled values.

entries.name: Compact property inspector
entries.summary: Group dimensions, icon choices and advanced properties in compact accessible sections.
constraints: The caller owns property semantics and validation. Short visual prefixes and icons retain full accessible names.

entries.name: Sized layout regions
entries.summary: Arrange weighted regions with bounded dimensions and local scrolling, container panels and local collapse, stacking columns in narrow containers.
constraints: The caller supplies validated dimensions and parent axes; layout grants no business access.

entries.name: Lifecycle status bar
entries.summary: Display declared record states and caller-allowed transitions.
constraints: Only the canonical action owner may authorize and apply a transition.

entries.name: Markdown display and editor
entries.summary: Read formatted content or edit its source with a shared preview.

entries.name: Authorized raster preview
entries.summary: Decode original attachment bytes and retain their confirmed identity and actual metadata.
constraints: The caller supplies authorized bytes and confirmed attachment metadata. Only PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP with bounded matching dimensions render inline; other formats keep metadata and downloads. Object URLs retire with bytes, scope or unmount.

entries.name: Metal button
entries.summary: Tactile metallic and liquid glass styled buttons for prominent actions.

entries.name: Set choice input
entries.summary: Present caller-owned string selections through shared toggles without dropping unmatched values.
constraints: The caller owns the original string set and query conditions. Toggles change one declared choice and preserve unmatched selections.
Optional whole-set clearing removes all selected values, including unmatched values.

entries.name: Semantic notice
entries.summary: Present caller-owned plain text with an accessible semantic tone.
constraints: The caller owns the condition and message. This component performs no queries, template execution or notification delivery.

entries.name: Notifications
entries.summary: Show unread changes and let the caller mark a notification as read.
constraints: The caller owns authorized original notifications, read decisions and navigation. Optional limits disclose the loaded range; read state changes only when the caller supplies confirmed data. Read-only or busy controls cannot initiate writes.

entries.name: Original availability history
entries.summary: Show a complete authorized average and explicit SLO beside original business-time samples.
constraints: The original summary and record window share their query scope and total. No synthetic 24-hour points, live heartbeat, signal stream or availability promise is created.

entries.name: Original observation statistics
entries.summary: Inspect original window statistics and latest samples using controlled signal, alarm and row-window parameters.
constraints: The caller supplies the confirmed full-window answer, latest sample and history. Scope and parameter mismatches hide old answers; loaded table rows never become the source of claimed complete statistics.

entries.name: Original observation table
entries.summary: Browse wide original observation windows with virtual rows and columns, pinned metadata and signal visibility.
constraints: The caller owns authorized business observation reads, original metadata, query scope, row selection confirmation and export. This UI performs no sampling, Worker simulation or tenant reads; a virtual viewport is not throughput evidence.

entries.name: Original observation time series
entries.summary: Plot three original numeric signals with stable record identity, actual timestamps and independent units.
constraints: The caller owns a scoped window of at most 500 original business observations. Nanosecond order and literal offsets are preserved; missing values break curves and missing event time never becomes a record index or render time.

entries.name: Page header
entries.summary: Give a task its title, description and visible actions.

entries.name: Cards and panels
entries.summary: Group related content with a shared heading, description and action area.

entries.name: Authorized PDF pages
entries.summary: Render actual PDF pages from authorized attachment bytes with caller-owned original page state.
constraints: The caller owns attachment authorization and the original page string. The lazy renderer uses bundled PDF.js, its same-version worker and fixed font assets; actual page and pixel budgets apply. PDF-provided URLs, scripts, forms, XFA and annotations are not activated.

entries.name: Pivot table
entries.summary: Compare aggregate groups with totals and explicit drill-down.

entries.name: Exact decimal progress
entries.summary: Show exact authorized scalar values with a bounded progress ratio.
constraints: The caller owns the original scalars and complete-set count. Invalid values never become zero or a denominator of one.

entries.name: Exact decimal range input
entries.summary: Edit two original text drafts on an exact decimal tick grid and clear them atomically.
constraints: The caller owns the original state pair and query conditions. Empty or invalid drafts are never replaced by bounds.

entries.name: Original row action grid
entries.summary: Stage typed original action parameters, review row revisions and retain refused inputs.
constraints: The caller owns original action permissions, all payload bindings and independent revision-bound decisions. Parameter projection never replaces record identity; closing the grid ends further submissions but does not cancel queued decisions.

entries.name: Authorized people avatars
entries.summary: Show the original first six people records as initials with their stable identities and complete authorized total.
constraints: The caller owns authorized people queries, field metadata and the complete total. Original order, names and IDs remain separate; initials never infer a member identity or replace missing records.

entries.name: Authorized record calendar
entries.summary: Browse original business dates by month and day and select original records.
constraints: The caller owns the bounded window and record authorization; the calendar never writes dates or reads another collection.

entries.name: Confirmed record summary
entries.summary: Present an original confirmed record through shared card and field formatters with explicit identity and properties.
constraints: The caller confirms original record access and supplies permission-filtered metadata. Titles and properties remain in their original field owners; the card performs no reads or writes.

entries.name: Record cards
entries.summary: Select original records from a caller-owned grid or list window.
constraints: Card fields come from permission-filtered metadata; the caller owns reads, selection and navigation.

entries.name: Ordered record chart
entries.summary: Plot original authorized records without merging equal axis labels or reading another collection.
constraints: The caller owns the ordered window, field permissions and point budget; this chart performs no reads or writes.

entries.name: Record discussion
entries.summary: Present original persisted comments and a caller-owned draft whose confirmation belongs to the host.
constraints: The caller owns authorization, the original bounded comment window, total and persistence. Unknown totals remain explicit; the presenter never invents authors, timestamps, comments or confirmations.

entries.name: Confirmed record comparison
entries.summary: Compare two to four complete original records with typed differences, stable identities and original field formatting.
constraints: The caller confirms every original record and supplies permission-filtered metadata. Values are compared by their declared scalar types; presentation performs no reads or writes and never truncates the selection.

entries.name: Authorized event list
entries.summary: Present ordered original business events with explicit time and severity tones.
constraints: The caller owns the authorized window and business time; the list does not create events or read another collection.

entries.name: Entity form
entries.summary: Edit declared entity fields using their shared validators and editors.
constraints: The caller owns persistence, authorization and conflict handling.

entries.name: Authorized task Gantt
entries.summary: Present original ordered business intervals on an explicit fixed UTC range.
constraints: The caller owns the authorized window; this presentation does not reorder records, filter by the viewport, or write dates.

entries.name: Original record journal
entries.summary: Present original change IDs, schemas, actors and field changes in their supplied order with an explicit display window.
constraints: The caller owns confirmed record reads and field metadata. Optional display limits disclose the loaded range and total; omitting a limit retains all supplied changes. No per-change revision or session action log is fabricated.

entries.name: Authorized lifecycle board
entries.summary: Select bounded records in their original lifecycle lanes and emit declared move commands.
constraints: The caller supplies authorized records, lifecycle states and actions. This component does not write state.

entries.name: Authorized record leaderboard
entries.summary: Present original host-ranked Top-N records and emit their original identities.
constraints: The caller owns the ranked query and record authorization. This component does not sort an unranked window or write records.

entries.name: Record list
entries.summary: Browse a scoped entity source with search, sort and paging.
constraints: An optional RecordEditPort supplies authorized displayed fields and the original revision-bound submit callback. Failed edits remain staged; the caller owns permissions and execution.
RecordColumnPresentation configures visible column titles, widths and typed formats without replacing field metadata or permissions. Hiding search retains the caller query.
RecordSelectionPort controls bounded selection in the current window; the caller confirms record permissions and owns pending, failure and cleanup. Window selection is not a complete matching set.

entries.name: Record lookup
entries.summary: Search a caller's scoped source to choose a reference by record ID.

entries.name: Record map
entries.summary: Explore original record coordinates with a bundled world background and stable record selection.
constraints: The caller supplies an authorized window of at most 100 records, typed WGS84 coordinate fields and scoped selection confirmation. The map never invents coordinates or reads remote tiles.

entries.name: Original record neighborhood
entries.summary: Arrange original bounded relationship groups around their confirmed record through the shared graph canvas.
constraints: The caller supplies authorized root and relationship windows with complete totals. The shared canvas preserves circular badges and original half-ellipse groups; it never guesses foreign-key joins or reads records.

entries.name: Record detail and history
entries.summary: Read a record's declared fields, related work and recorded changes.
constraints: Visibility and allowed actions come from the scoped source and caller.

entries.name: Authorized record scatter plot
entries.summary: Plot original numeric record coordinates and retain independently selectable stable identities.
constraints: The caller owns the ordered authorized window and confirmation. Missing coordinates are excluded; invalid values refuse the plot, and overlapping points remain separate records.

entries.name: Original scalar and record sparkline
entries.summary: Present a caller-owned scalar and original ordered record values without inventing time or replacing missing data.
constraints: The caller owns scalar precision, authorized window and field metadata. Missing values break the line; points retain stable IDs and never read or write records.

entries.name: Authorized record timeline
entries.summary: Display a bounded record window as time points or intervals, grouped by an original resource field.
constraints: The caller supplies authorized records and selection. This component does not schedule or write records.

entries.name: Record attachment uploader
entries.summary: Select a real local file and explicitly upload it through the caller's confirmed-record attachment path.
constraints: The caller owns the actual File, bytes upload, attach decision and confirmed metadata. Refusal preserves the selected file; this control reports no simulated progress or local filename as a confirmed attachment.

entries.name: Record list and detail
entries.summary: Keep record browsing and focused detail in one responsive task frame.
constraints: Pass a scoped RecordSource; this layout does not define a business entity.

entries.name: Original resource rows
entries.summary: Present twelve original record rows with their real titles, statuses and caller-owned selection.
constraints: The caller owns the authorized first window, complete total, visible title/status fields and output confirmation. Duplicate names retain original record IDs; the list performs no reads or writes.

entries.name: Retro button
entries.summary: Tactile mechanical keycap buttons styled after industrial equipment.

entries.name: 3D scene
entries.summary: Inspect authorized self-contained GLB geometry, model parts, layers and actual typed field mappings.
constraints: WebGL2 is required. The caller supplies a confirmed asset and attachment; sample mappings require the actual asset reference. No simulation, default asset or external model resource is used.

entries.name: Interactive Search Around
entries.summary: Explore original relationship counts, walk and return along a controlled record path, and independently select output records.
constraints: The caller owns the original root, retained relationship reads, typed result windows, path and confirmed outputs. Unknown or refused counts never become zero; callbacks preserve original object and record identities.

entries.name: Scoped search input
entries.summary: Edit caller-owned search text and show the actual readable object scope.
constraints: The caller owns text, object scope and authorized reads. This control performs no queries and does not promise global ontology search.

entries.name: Semantic separator
entries.summary: Separate operator groups with an optional literal label and accessible identity.
constraints: The caller owns the label and visibility. The separator is horizontal and noninteractive, without data reads or text evaluation.

entries.name: Detail sheet
entries.summary: Inspect or edit details while keeping the underlying task in view.

entries.name: Static URL image
entries.summary: Display the original public image URL, caption and cover height through the browser image element.
constraints: The caller owns the fixed URL configuration. Only HTTP(S) absolute or single-root-relative public paths render; loading and failure remain explicit. Published URL configuration does not freeze remote bytes or authorize attachments.

entries.name: Semantic status tags
entries.summary: Map actual domain or kernel states to a label and one of five tones.
constraints: Use exact registry keys; unknown states fall back to a neutral label.

entries.name: Authorized summary statistics
entries.summary: Present five measures from one complete authorized aggregate answer.
constraints: The caller owns the original five-measure answer. Counts remain exact; missing numeric measures remain empty.

entries.name: Boolean switch
entries.summary: Toggle one caller-owned boolean with explicit checked and disabled states.
constraints: The caller owns the boolean and its effects; this control does not coerce unrelated values or write records.

entries.name: Counted tag groups
entries.summary: Present complete original scalar counts as fixed-size tags with optional caller-owned group selection.
constraints: The caller owns authorized complete counts and filter writes. Null, empty and literal groups retain their original identities; missing groups cannot be written to text filters. No array expansion, string coercion or record reads happen here.

entries.name: Tasks and inbox
entries.summary: Present assigned work with the answers and actions supplied by its owner.
constraints: An inbox preview is not an approval or permission engine.

entries.name: Counted term labels
entries.summary: Present complete caller-owned counts as bounded frequency-scaled literal labels.
constraints: The caller owns authorized complete counts and stable order. Empty text and null remain distinct; this control performs no queries or mutations.

entries.name: Multiple choices
entries.summary: Switch several named choices on or off without a custom control.

entries.name: Hierarchy selection
entries.summary: Select a row from a small hierarchy of labelled records.
constraints: Rows are always expanded; collapse and full tree keyboard navigation are not implemented.

entries.name: Virtual item list
entries.summary: Render measured rows by stable identity and retain the focused item.
constraints: The caller owns data reads and item state; offscreen local inputs are disposed.

entries.name: Workbench
entries.summary: The one editor container: breadcrumbs, status, history and publish actions, structure panel, main view, inspector and a diagnostics dock with remembered sizes.
